summary: Taipei, Sept. 19 (CNA) Palmer Luckey, founder of U.S.-based Anduril Industries, said Saturday that delayed U.S. arms sales under U.S. President Donald Trump are affecting his company's business, a matter he said he has raised personally with Trump.

title: 'Sound-bite democracy' threatens elections: Tang Prize laureate
summary: Taipei, Sept. 19 (CNA) The internet is enabling demagogues to win democratic elections through rapid, emotionally charged messaging, posing a growing threat to constitutional government, 2026 Tang Prize laureate Bruce Ackerman said Saturday.

title: Allies call for Taiwan's inclusion in joint letter to United Nations
summary: Washington, Sept. 19 (CNA) Permanent representatives to the United Nations from five of Taiwan's diplomatic allies sent a joint letter to U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres on Friday, calling for the country's inclusion in the world governing body.

summary: Taipei, Sept. 18 (CNA) Five televised forums or debates on a referendum seeking to abolish Taiwan's policy of creating a "nuclear-free homeland" will begin on Nov. 12, the Central Election Commission (CEC) announced on Friday.

title: President Lai attends eastern Taiwan quake drill observed by 18 countries
summary: Taipei, Sept. 18 (CNA) President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) on Friday inspected a large-scale earthquake disaster response drill in eastern Taiwan, attended by representatives from 18 countries and more than 150 international search-and-rescue and medical personnel.
